name: Shinsetsu Kamiya Ukyou ~Untrue~
source:
Events take place between those happening in Ivory Tower and Missing Link. There is no detective story this time. Instead, there is a story of human relations. The client is a girl who had a relative stabbed in the heart. That's the fact that can can no longer be divided between falsehood and truth... "Untrue".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
事件發生在《Ivory Tower》和《Missing Link》之間。這次沒有偵探故事。談的是人與人之間的關係。客戶是一位女孩，她的親戚被刺傷了心臟。這就是事實，不能再區分謊言和真理……「不真實」。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]］
